/interface bridge add name=bridge port-cost-mode=short vlan-filtering=yes

/interface vlan add interface=bridge name=vlan103-mgmt vlan-id=103
/interface bonding add mode=802.3ad name=bond-ponderosa-gw slaves=sfp-sfpplus1-ponderosa-gw-a,sfp-sfpplus2-ponderosa-gw-b transmit-hash-policy=layer-2-and-3
/interface wireless security-profiles set [ find default=yes ] supplicant-identity=MikroTik
/ip smb users set [ find default=yes ] disabled=yes
/port set 0 name=serial0
/system logging action set 0 memory-lines=65535
/system logging action set 3 remote=172.18.84.101
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge disabled=yes interface=ether1 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10 pvid=103
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge disabled=yes interface=ether2 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10 pvid=103

/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=bond-ponderosa-gw internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10 pvid=666
/ip firewall connection tracking set udp-timeout=10s
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge comment=maple-bh-hawthorn2-60 tagged=bond-ponderosa-gw vlan-ids=100
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge comment=maple-bmorg tagged=bond-ponderosa-gw untagged=ether9-ponderosa-sw-ocotillo2-a,ether11-ponderosa--sw-ocotillo2-b,ether12,ether13-ponderosa-back-redwood-ap,ether14,ether15-ponderosa-smoketree-sweetgum-ap,ether16,ether19-ponderosa-switch-ocotillo2-c vlan-ids=2000
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge comment=maple-public disabled=yes tagged=bond-ponderosa-gw untagged=ether17-outdoor-ap,ether18,ether20,ether21,ether22 vlan-ids=2010
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge comment=glch-st-maple-05 tagged=bridge,bond-ponderosa-gw vlan-ids=110
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge comment=mgmt tagged=bridge,bond-ponderosa-gw vlan-ids=103
/interface ovpn-server server add mac-address=02:AB:B2:73:C1:4A name=ovpn-server1
/ip dhcp-client add interface=vlan103-mgmt
/ip dns set servers=192.0.2.8,198.18.11.4
/ip ipsec profile set [ find default=yes ] dpd-interval=2m dpd-maximum-failures=5
/ip route add disabled=yes dst-address=0.0.0.0/0 gateway=172.26.4.33 routing-table=main suppress-hw-offload=no
/ip smb shares set [ find default=yes ] directory=/flash/pub
/ip ssh set always-allow-password-login=yes forwarding-enabled=local
/system clock set time-zone-autodetect=no time-zone-name=US/Pacific
/system identity set name=ponderosa-sw
/system logging set 0 topics=info,!account
/system logging add action=remote topics=info
/system logging add action=remote topics=warning
/system logging add action=remote topics=error
/system logging add action=disk topics=info,!account
/system logging add action=disk topics=warning
/system logging add action=disk topics=error
/system ntp client set enabled=yes
/system package update set channel=long-term
/system routerboard settings set auto-upgrade=yes
/tool romon set enabled=yes
/tool sniffer set file-name=ponderosa-sw.pcap filter-interface=ether10-cottonwood-relay filter-operator-between-entries=and
